pose_rules.canonical_site: at least 70 percent of ligand heavy atoms within 4.0 A of frozen homologous superpocket spheres
pose_rules.severe_protein_clash: one or more ligand-protein heavy-atom pairs below 2.0 A
pose_rules.sam_compatibility: incompatible below 2.0 A; close_nonoverlapping from 2.0 A to below 2.5 A; compatible at or above 2.5 A
pose_rules.clustering: complete-linkage direct coordinate RMSD at 2.0 A; identical atom order required
pose_rules.representative: geometric medoid minimizing mean within-family RMSD; seed then mode tie-break; engine score unused

interference_rules.direct_overlap: candidate-TSL heavy-atom minimum distance below 2.0 A
interference_rules.transfer_corridor_blockade: candidate atom projects within SAM-CE-to-TSL-S segment and lies at or below 2.0 A

evidence_policy.dcmb_role: METTL7A experimental inhibition anchor and mechanistic comparator, not expected inverse template
